thread:
elena_support: Heads-up — multiple customers (Acme, OmniPay) opened escalations 30m ago complaining about changed answer style after today's rollout (v2026-03-17-rc2). They say shorter, more directive responses and some hallucinated IDs.

tom_cs: Screenshot from Acme attached in ticket. They have a saved prompt that now returns different invoice numbers.

elena_support: Repro steps from Acme: curl to /v1/generate with model=redwood-chat-3b:rc2, prompt includes 'return recent invoice  ID for order 834' — prior model returned the stored ID; rc2 invents 7-digit ID.

priya_ml: Thanks — did they specify temperature / sampling?

elena_support: default params: temperature=0.0, top_p unset, max_tokens=120.

sam_eng: Is this only with redwood-chat-3b:rc2 or also other variants?

elena_support: They've only tested rc2 and the pinned 1.9 in prod; 1.9 looks fine per their tests.

priya_ml: Sounds like a behavior regression from the new policy/decoding changes in rc2. Can you paste a minimal curl and a diff of outputs?

elena_support: Minimal repro (from ticket):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-3b:rc2","input":"Return recent invoice ID for order 834"}'
```

Previous (1.9): "Invoice ID: 000834-AC"
rc2: "Invoice ID: 7239182"

jordan_oncall: We're seeing similar anomaly in telemetry — spike in 'entity_invented' metric for rc2 routes starting ~09:12 UTC.

micah_platform: Canary rollout was 20% traffic. Did routing accidentally expand?

sam_eng: Checking deploy logs...@deploy-bot can you show rollout status for redwood-chat-3b:rc2?

deploy-bot: Rollout status for redwood-chat-3b:rc2: desired=5 pods, running=5 pods, traffic=20%, started=2026-03-17T09:00:05Z. No automatic promotion detected.

sam_eng: Ok not auto-promoted. Priya, quick idea: is this change from new decoding config or model weights? Any A/B evals flagged?

priya_ml: The evals showed slight increase in precision tradeoff from LM-finetune changes; nothing that should invent factual IDs. Could be a prompt-sensitivity side effect. Need quick repro locally.

micah_platform: We can immediate-fallback routing rc2 traffic to 1.9. Command to update routing policy:

```
# promote 100% traffic to redwood-chat-3b:1.9
rwctl routing set --model redwood-chat-3b --variant 1.9 --traffic 100
```

sam_eng: Jordan, can you run that if we agree? We'll monitor customer threads before wider rollback.

jordan_oncall: I can run. Two quick asks: (1) confirm stakeholder sign-off, (2) snapshot rc2 logs for forensic.

tom_cs: Customer-facing note: We'll tell Acme/OmniPay we are rolling back the recent variant and investigating. Draft: "We're reverting to the previous model version; you should see behavior restored within minutes. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

elena_support: Ack. I already posted that to both customers.

priya_ml: Before rollback: capture a small batch of failing requests and token-level probs. Use this query to sample logs:

```
# sample failed responses where model=rc2 and metric=entity_invented > 0.8
logs query "model:redwood-chat-3b:rc2 AND entity_invented:>0.8" --limit 200
```

micah_platform: I'll take a snapshot of rc2 pods (kv cache, kernel selection) and save model artifact hash.

jordan_oncall: Performing fallback now. Running command...

ops_bot: ACTION by jordan_oncall: routing update initiated at 2026-03-17T09:42:30Z

ops_bot: routing update completed: redwood-chat-3b:1.9 is now receiving 100% traffic.

sam_eng: Confirming metrics: latency stable, error rate unchanged. Priya, can you run quick diff on outputs for a canonical prompt set?

priya_ml: Running evals now on saved sample — will post results in 10 min. Initial note: many rc2 responses show lower token logprobs at entity spans. Could be decoding beam/penalty change.

elena_support: Customers confirm behavior has reverted for their saved prompt. Acme: "responses look back to normal".

tom_cs: Great. Next steps: Priya to root-cause, Micah to artifact/log snapshot, Sam to prepare rollback playbook for PMs, Elena to keep customers updated.

priya_ml: I'll open an internal bug with tags ml/regression/rc2 and link eval artifacts.

micah_platform: Saved rc2 pod snapshots to s3://redwood-dumps/regressions/1957770000/ and archived kernel logs.

jordan_oncall: Leaving traffic on 1.9. If any customer requests re-test we can spin a canary of rc2 with stricter decoding parity flags: --decoding-profile=legacy.

elena_support: Thanks all. Closing fast path here; will update if customers re-open. :thumbsup:
